values.note: Reservations for the coming year open June 1. Primitive reservations hold a space, not a site: placement in the open primitive area is first-come. Sturgis Rally stays are booked by phone.

City of Spearfish 2027 fees: RVs in the primitive area $42 a night, full hookup $52, premium (P1-P6, 30 and 1) $63; off-season nights (October, January-April) $21 with electric and sewer. Sturgis Rally rates run much higher (full hookup $125, premium $136).

note: City of Spearfish campground along Spearfish Creek beside the D.C. Booth Historic Fish Hatchery and City Park; reach it through downtown from I-90 exit 12 (the Highway 14 entrance GPS suggests is closed). Premium sites P1-P6 back onto the recreation path along the creek and sites 2-11 are near it; an open primitive area takes RVs of any size. --Claude
